other_failure_modes.description: The agent overwrites the original 'id' column in the test set with a newly generated sequential range. If the evaluation platform expects the original test set IDs to match predictions, this will cause the submission to fail automated evaluation.

summary: The agent successfully implements a Factorization Machine with a custom ranking loss but neglects feature engineering and relies on a single run of a stochastic model.
